lede: Voice AI platform usability study: How easily can different user types navigate Retell's dashboard to accomplish common voice agent tasks?
comparison_note: Insights compared against Bland AI and Vapi data from the existing competitive study. Focus on dashboard UX — no voice credits used.

personas.name: Alex Rivera
personas.bio: Platform Engineer at a mid-size SaaS company. Responsible for integrating voice AI into their customer support system. Cares about API quality, webhooks, and developer experience.

personas.name: Sarah Chen
personas.bio: Product Manager evaluating voice AI vendors for a new IVR feature. Needs to understand pricing, capabilities, and time-to-value. Will present findings to leadership.

personas.name: Jordan Taylor
personas.bio: Solutions Engineer who deploys voice AI for enterprise customers. Needs to quickly set up agents, configure prompts, and troubleshoot issues.

personas.name: Maya Patel
personas.bio: Startup founder building an AI-first customer service tool. Evaluating voice platforms for an investor demo in 48 hours. Needs fast time-to-working-demo.

tasks.title: Create a voice agent
tasks.prompt: As a first-time user exploring Retell AI, navigate to create a new voice agent. Reach the agent creation form or builder and explore what options are available for configuring a new agent. Stop once you can see the creation interface — do NOT actually publish or save an agent.
tasks.success_criteria: Agent creation form/builder is visible with configuration options

tasks.title: Configure voice and prompt
tasks.prompt: Find where to configure the voice (voice selection, voice settings) and the prompt/instructions for a voice agent. Explore what voice options are available and how prompts are structured. Note the customization options.
tasks.success_criteria: Voice selection and prompt configuration UI is visible

tasks.title: Find phone number management
tasks.prompt: Locate the phone numbers section. Find where you can view owned numbers, buy new numbers, or import existing numbers. Explore what phone number options are available.
tasks.success_criteria: Phone numbers page or section is visible

tasks.title: Find pricing and billing
tasks.prompt: Find pricing information for Retell AI. Look for pricing page, billing section, or usage/cost information. Understand the cost model (per minute, per call, subscription, etc.).
tasks.success_criteria: Pricing or billing information is visible

tasks.title: Find API and integration docs
tasks.prompt: Find the API documentation, developer docs, or integration guides. Look for API keys, webhooks, or SDK information. Explore what integration options are available for developers.
tasks.success_criteria: API documentation or developer resources are visible
